notes: The page gives an asserted canonical isomorphism (23), with a marginal correction asking for an equivalence, and says that it is compatible with the action of Γ=Aut G. It introduces the mixed multiplicity (M_G, Γ)=M_[G] in (24) and describes it through the moduli interpretation for the fibred groupoid of relative curves of the given type. This is a description of what the ink says, not an independent mathematical check. The singular article before groupoïde remains only the preferred reading, despite the grammatical fit. The first formula subscript remains doubtful without an invented revision sequence. The opening canceled word is retained as qui|que, since not every letter is plain. H's closing note about continuation and its document terminator are editorial material and have not been entered as source-text disagreements. H's additional près and its alternative opening wording belong to the same altered assertion; the two associated substantive rows are flagged as potentially consequential. The underline in the margin and the literal spelling standart are preserved. All existing source agreement, including punctuation and formulas, was inspected visually rather than adopted on witness agreement. Additional uncertainty alone at le|les|la and M0942 does not create a substantive change row.

Independent audit: the opening final e/s is now explicitly uncertain. The canceled qui/que and overworked G subscript remain unresolved. The abbreviation after deuxième has m and a tall b on the same baseline, without separate re or an independent abbreviation point. Est un is heavily retraced but has no distinct cancellation line or raised replacement baseline, so it stays live. The final article admits la as well as le/les because its low body is retraced; the live spelling remains standart. The full formulas (23) and (24), including the single-wave equivalence sign and bracketed G, were inspected. Script M has a curved left entry/foot on this sheet and scan019, contrasting with the upright first stems inspected in scan022 B03. No independent check of the asserted equivalence or moduli interpretation was performed.
